learning_paths.title: Beginner: Introduction to Generative AI
learning_paths.description: This learning path provides an overview of generative AI concepts, from the fundamentals of large language models to responsible AI principles.

courses.title: Introduction to Generative AI
courses.description: Introductory level microlearning course aimed at explaining what Generative AI is, how it is used, and how it differs from traditional machine learning methods.

courses.title: Introduction to Large Language Models
courses.description: Introductory level micro-learning course that explores what large language models (LLM) are, the use cases where they can be utilized, and how you can use prompt tuning to enhance LLM performance.

courses.title: Introduction to Responsible AI
courses.description: Introductory-level microlearning course aimed at explaining what responsible AI is, why it's important, and how Google implements responsible AI in their products.

courses.title: Prompt Design in Vertex AI
courses.description: Complete the introductory Prompt Design in Vertex AI skill badge to demonstrate skills in the following: prompt engineering, image analysis, and multimodal generative techniques, within Vertex AI.

courses.title: Responsible AI: Applying AI Principles with Google Cloud
courses.description: As the use of enterprise Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning continues to grow, so too does the importance of building it responsibly.
